svg.title: Memory: a notebook the agent keeps across runs
svg.desc: The model gets four tools, write_memory, read_memory, delete_memory and search_memory, over a notebook of Markdown files kept in a store such as FileStore, SqliteMemoryStore or PostgresMemoryStore. Your code picks the namespace, such as the user ID from the run dependencies, so the model cannot reach another user's files, and writes are compare-and-swap. On the first request of a run, Memory adds a <memory> block with an excerpt of MEMORY.md and the names of the other files next to the user's prompt, only when memory changed, within max_tokens.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
